entries.title: Ask HN: Small product, single founder success stories?
entries.author: thunga
entries.current_title: Ask HN: Small product, single founder success stories?
entries.excerpt: I have read some small product, single founder success stories on HN over the last few years. Can you share some stories/links even though it has been shared before on an unrelated thread? On HN, patio11, edw519, peldi & jacques have all shared success stories before. I am interested to know more. EDIT : By success, I mean happiness in life & financial independence to do interesting things in life.
entries.guide_zh: 寻找单人创办、小产品起步的成功案例，看看不扩团队能走多远。

entries.title: Ask PG: What has changed since you wrote Hackers and Painters in 2004?
entries.author: flavio87
entries.current_title: Ask PG: What has changed since you wrote Hackers and Painters in 2004?
entries.excerpt: I'm thinking of buying your book, but since it is from 2004 I was just wondering if there are any key findings or events that would have dramatically changed your viewpoint on certain of the issues you write about, so I could bear that in mind while reading. Maybe are you planning to release an updated version in the near future?
entries.guide_zh: 《黑客与画家》出版多年，作者询问哪些新变化可能修正书中的观点。

entries.title: Ask HN: I am wasting so much of time, what can I do?
entries.author: ahmedaly
entries.current_title: Ask HN: I am wasting so much of time, what can I do?
entries.excerpt: Hi guys.. I am wasting so much of time, working few hours, although I have so much of work and pressure, but I am still just surfing the internet and waste time.. I hardly deliver jobs on time, and my clients are annoyed because of that. What can I do to solve this horrible issue? Any tips pls?
entries.guide_zh: 任务多、压力大，却仍不断上网耗时，作者请求改善拖延的建议。

I hear algorithms-type questions come up a lot, so I would like to prepare

entries.title: Ask HN: I think My code isn't Good enough
entries.author: mabid
entries.current_title: Ask HN: I think My code isn't Good enough
entries.excerpt: I have been programming for the last 4-5 years but whenever I look at some good code written by some one else I always have this feeling that my code isnt good enough. By "good enough" I mean that my code isn't as beautiful(readable) and reusable. I always try to change the way i do things the next time but i keep getting this feeling. Do you guys ever fell like this and what you think I should do to improve on that ?
entries.guide_zh: 编程四五年后仍觉得代码不如别人，作者想知道如何面对和提升。

entries.title: Ask HN: European startup looking for a service for recurring billing
entries.author: davidvanleeuwen
entries.current_title: Ask HN: European startup looking for a service for recurring billing
entries.excerpt: We love Stripe, Samurai, Braintree and services like that. Unfortunately, they're not available for companies outside of the US. Most people say that we need to use Paypal. But we prefer to work with Stripe for example, because it really looks like a great service and a service with a refreshing way of working with payments. Does anyone know or have experience with using a recurring service that is accessible for European companies?
entries.guide_zh: 美国常用服务尚未覆盖欧洲，欧洲创业公司该选什么周期扣款方案？
